title: Cordyceps Energy Gummies
body_html:
Cordyceps Energy Gummies deliver a powerful blend of ingredients designed to support energy, focus, and overall performance. The formula features cordyceps mushroom extract, traditionally valued for supporting vitality and physical endurance. It is complemented by GABA, ginkgo leaf, L-glutamine, and DMAE — ingredients commonly used to help support normal cognitive function, mental clarity, and alertness.

These strawberry-flavored gummies provide a convenient and enjoyable alternative to capsules or powders. The chewable format makes supplementation simple and accessible, whether you are preparing for a workout, study session, gaming session, or busy workday. With their pleasant taste and portable format, they make it easy to stay consistent with your wellness routine.

Cordyceps Energy Gummies are ideal for students, athletes, and gamers looking to support energy levels and normal mental performance during demanding activities. Many people include functional mushrooms and cognitive-supporting nutrients as part of a balanced lifestyle to help maintain focus and stamina throughout the day. With their functional ingredient blend and convenient gummy format, these gummies offer a modern way to support everyday performance and productivity.*


Ingredients: Cordyceps Extract (200 mg), GABA (25 mg), Ginkgo Leaf (25 mg), L-Glutamine (25 mg), DMAE (25 mg), Organic Cane Sugar, Tapioca Syrup, Purified Water, Citrus Pectin, Citric Acid, Strawberry Natural Flavor, Sodium Citrate, Color from Beet Powder.
Manufacturer's country: USA
Product amount (oz/lbs/g): 30 gummies / 4.8 oz / 0.3 lbs / 136 g
Gross weight (oz/lbs/g): 5.9 oz / 0.4 lbs/ 167g
Suggested use: Take one (1) to two (2) gummies daily.
Warning: Do not exceed recommended dose. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under the age of 18, and individuals with a known medical condition should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement.
KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN. DO NOT USE IF SAFETY SEAL IS DAMAGED OR MISSING. STORE IN A COOL, DRY PLACE.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
